name: Kestra
description: Event-driven workflow orchestration platform for scheduling and automating data, AI, and infrastructure pipelines.

ram_min_mb.quote: A Kestra standalone server requires at least 4 GiB of memory and 2 vCPUs.

cpu_min_cores.quote: A Kestra standalone server requires at least 4 GiB of memory and 2 vCPUs.

no_official_figure.note: The requirements page states only the standalone-server minimum (4 GiB / 2 vCPUs); beyond that it directs readers to 'contact us' for deployment-specific sizing guidance rather than publishing a single general recommended figure.

deps.note: Kestra Open Source requires PostgreSQL OR MySQL for the queue/repository backend, not both — modeled as two independently-optional entries per the OR-flattening rule (Defect Class #11); do not read required:false on both as dependency-free.
